research: Read the strategy packet (true facts, the Black Friday Sale 2026 campaign facts, the footage tags, B004-B020 for the Hobo Bag) and docs/research/2026-10-black-friday-and-bag-ads.md: BFCM statics win with one big visual and one offer line; gifting formats; hooks that state the offer in the first line; no countdown graphics.

The client's four ideas are the four projects, one each: the second bag at the 60% two-bag price (P01), one for you / one for her (P02), Black Friday prices are live now (P03), Christmas gifts for mum, sister and best friend (P04). The gift terms are only the campaign's (Wouter 2026-10-23, data/campaign.json): 2 bags = free mirrored jewellery box, 3+ bags = jewellery box + free cosmetic bag, 60% off only of 2 or 3 bags together, only bags count, while stocks last.

Earlier Hobo Bag batches did a pack-out, a behind-you demo, a gift checklist (three boxes), five checks, three people on a list, a Black Friday walk, myths and a retirement for the old bag (B014/B016), and the winners remixes (B019/B020): none built the order around the second bag, a you/her pairing, three buyer questions, or the three-bag tier, so those are the four structures here.

Compliance choices: no sale end date, no countdown, no first person, nothing about what a mum, sister or friend said or felt; recipients appear only as names on a list ('for mum'), the voice is a host in 'you' form; jewellery box and cosmetic bag appear only as the campaign states them; no price numbers (they change).

projects.title: Add a second bag
projects.big_idea: Build the order step by step: one Hobo Bag at its own Black Friday price with the free matching pouch wallet, then add a second and the 60% bundle price applies.
projects.why_new: First Hobo Bag video built as an order ladder around the second bag and the 60% two-bag bundle price; earlier Black Friday videos sold one bag at 50% and never the 2-bag bundle.

chapters.text: Start with one Hobo Bag. It is fifty percent off right now, and a matching pouch wallet comes free.
Here is what that one bag does. A hidden pocket on the back sits flat against you, for your passport and cards. Two gold side zips are there for your keys and phone.
Inside, divided compartments mean nothing sinks to the bottom. Two straps let you wear it on the shoulder, as a handbag, or crossbody.
Now add a second one. You get sixty percent off the regular price when you buy two bags together.
Pick the same colour twice, or two different ones. There are six colours to choose from, from Galaxy Black to Burgundy.
The Hobo Bag comes with a matching pouch wallet, free, so your bag and its little partner always match.
Soft, water-resistant leather that looks expensive and only gets better with time. Free US shipping and a one-year warranty come with it.
Black Friday prices are live now. One Hobo Bag is fifty percent off with a free matching pouch wallet, and two or three bags together get sixty percent off. Tap the link below.

chapters.text: Here is a gift idea that works for her and for you. Two Hobo Bags: one to give, one to keep.
Two straps give the bag three ways to wear. She can carry it on the shoulder, as a handbag, or crossbody. So can you.
It works hard for both of you. A hidden pocket on the back sits flat against you, and keeps your passport and cards right there.
A gold zip on each side takes keys and a phone, so they are always one hand away.
And divided compartments inside keep the rest in order, so nothing sinks to the bottom of either bag.
The soft, water-resistant leather looks expensive and only gets better with time. It is a gift that looks the part, and a treat that does too.
You get sixty percent off the regular price when you buy the two together. One bag for you, one bag for her.
Buy two bags and you also get a free jewellery box, while stocks last. One for you, one for her. Tap the link below.

A hidden pocket on the back sits flat against you, for your passport and cards. A gold zip on each side takes your keys and phone.

chapters.text: For mum: soft, water-resistant leather that looks expensive and only gets better with time. A bag that looks right under the tree.
For a sister: two straps, so the bag goes on the shoulder, as a handbag, or crossbody. One bag, three ways to carry it.
For a best friend: a gold zip on each side for keys and phone, and divided compartments inside so nothing sinks to the bottom.
All three get the same hidden pocket on the back. It sits flat against the body, for a passport and cards.
Pick a colour for each name, or one colour for all three.
Buying all three at once? You get sixty percent off the regular price when you buy three bags together.
With three bags you also get two free gifts: a mirrored jewellery box and a cosmetic bag. Only bags count, not accessories.
Buy two bags and you also get a free jewellery box, while stocks last. Buy three and the cosmetic bag comes too. Tap the link below.
